name: codex-native-scheduler
description: Quota-aware Codex task scheduler with English and Simplified Chinese UI, exact-time execution, durable multi-task queue, checkpointed auto-resume, repo/thread safety, approval safety, and quota-free local management.

interface.shortDescription: Schedule and safely resume Codex work across usage windows · 中英文界面
interface.longDescription: Use the local scheduler in English or Simplified Chinese to select real Codex conversations, models, reasoning, skills, exact date/time and prompts. Tasks can wait for quota/model/network/project availability, checkpoint interrupted work, resume the same conversation without repeating completed work, serialize writes to the same repo/thread, require interactive approval for sensitive actions, and notify you when attention is needed.
defaultPrompt: Open the Codex Scheduler visual picker.
